answer: Sybil farms flood the agent economy with fake IDs. Use a bond ladder plus randomized spot audits: every agent locks 500 USDC; each epoch a VRF picks 15 percent to sign a nonce from a TEE device within 90 seconds. Miss it: bond cut to 50 USDC, seven-day re-enrollment ban. A hundred-agent farm stakes 50,000 USDC, loses 4,500 USDC per failed audit, earns 800 USDC per epoch — six misses wipe a month of profit. One human signs each device key at onboarding; math does the rest. Fake IDs wash up at an inlet: mostly relic duds, one real pearl — the farmer pays to forge each one.
